procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: A few seconds after the first attempt to start Youth Men Yellow fleet, the race committee displayed the first substitute with two sounds.
While the general recall flag was displayed, support vessel 70 approached the stern of the race committee signal vessel. Support vessel 70 was within 15 meters of the signal vessel.
A member of the international jury approached support vessel 70 and warned the driver that the support vessel could not be in the starting area.
The driver of the support vessel responded that he could be there. He then slowly motored away.
The race committee again attempted to start the race and again displayed the general recall signal shortly after the starting signal.
Also again, support vessel 70 entered the starting area and approached the stern of the race committee signal vessel.
The same member of the international jury came alongside support vessel 70 and explained that support vessel 70 was breaking a rule by being in the starting area.
The driver of support vessel 70 calmly argued that he could be there because the racing was postponed.
The member of the international jury notified the driver of support vessel 70 that a report would be made to the international jury alleging a breach of a rule.
conclusions: The general recall signal displayed by the race committee was neither a postponement nor an abandonment of race 1. The Support Vessel Regulations are rules included in the notice of race. By being within 100 meters of the starting line and marks from after the time of the preparatory signal and before all boats had left the starting area, or the race committee signaled a postponement or abandonment, support vessel 70 broke Support Vessel Regulation 5.1.2.
decision: The international jury issues a warning to support vessel 70 and the support person aboard, Andreas Lage.

The following boats are warned that if support vessel 70 or Andreas Lage commit a further breach after this warning, a penalty may be imposed on them: USA 222168 MEX 216210 USA 218610 USA 220978 USA 218652
